display_name: Obstructive/Mixed Apnea Index: (Obstructive apneas with >=4% oxygen desaturation or with arousal +mixed apneas with >=4% oxygen desaturation or with arousal) / hour of sleep from type I polysomnography
description: Calculated - Obstructive/Mixed Apnea Index (4% desats) with arousals
calculation: 60*(oarba4 + oaroa4 + oanba4 + oanoa4 + marbpa + maropa + manrbpa + manropa)/slpprdp
